dedupe_resolutions.notes: Vance's end-times statement was made in a broad faith interview and did not explicitly concern Iran or any particular official act. It remains a distinct governance and risk-framing statement rather than being merged into the Iran/Hormuz war record.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The shared White House fact sheet reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One record concerns announced company agreements; the other concerns an administration-reported program measurement.

The August employment release is an independently measured economic outcome. Trump's subsequent trade threat used the report as context but is a distinct presidential risk statement with no implementing instrument; neither record substitutes for the other.

The September 4 orders direct ranching, competition, processing, wolf and labeling actions. The August 26 proclamation separately implemented a temporary lean-beef import quota increase; the instruments and outcome tests are distinct.

The national measles surveillance outcome concerns a vaccine-preventable infectious disease. The August 31 newborn record measures vitamin K nonreceipt, which is not a vaccine and involves a different intervention, population and outcome.

LEG-004706 records the June 22 district-court summary judgment vacating modified SAVE. The new record covers the September 4 appellate refusal to stay that judgment and the expedited merits appeal; both stages remain cross-referenced under the same litigation.

The Central African Republic record covers a second implemented flight to that country. The Guyana record covers the first implemented group under a separate bilateral arrangement, different people and different post-transfer terms.

The Liberia record documents a separate agreement and capacity announcement. The Guyana record documents actual arrival of a different six-person group under a one-year temporary arrangement; neither is a duplicate of the other.

rejected_candidates.title: Truth Social Iran and territorial propaganda images
rejected_candidates.reason: Image-only posts depicted explosions around ships, a person smashing a map of Iran and a map labeling the Strait of Hormuz as 'New U.S. Territory.' They establish that Trump published the imagery, not a new operation, territorial claim with legal effect or verified military result, and remain only in the raw feed.

rejected_candidates.title: Reported DHS referral concerning state voter data
rejected_candidates.reason: Trump linked to a September 4 Just the News report saying DHS referred potential Driver's Privacy Protection Act violations involving state voter data to DOJ. No public referral document, DOJ confirmation of an opened investigation or independent corroboration was located, and the report predates this window; it remains a lead rather than a canonical investigation record.

rejected_candidates.title: Truth Social jobs and tourism claims
rejected_candidates.reason: Posts promoted a derivative gender breakdown of employment and a tourism-boom article. The August jobs release is already recorded, the posts disclosed no new federal instrument and no sufficiently material independently measured policy effect warranted a parallel record.

rejected_candidates.title: UN reform promise, Fox censorship allegation and congressional document demand
rejected_candidates.reason: An ambassador's NATO-style UN reform promise had no formal proposal or implemented U.S. action; a White House official's Fox censorship allegation lacked independent evidence; and Representative Jim Jordan's document demand was congressional oversight activity rather than an administration lifecycle change.

rejected_candidates.title: New Mexico renaming suggestion
rejected_candidates.reason: Trump suggested renaming New Mexico to 'New America' and repeated an unsupported election allegation. The statement identified no federal authority, order, proposal process or implemented naming action and remains rhetoric in the raw feed.

rejected_candidates.title: Truth Social campaign activity and self-promotion
rejected_candidates.reason: Convention promotion, a state-attorney-general endorsement, book promotion, personal praise and ideological video reposts were campaign or promotional material without a material federal action.

rejected_candidates.title: Mail-ballot and diplomatic follow-up coverage
rejected_candidates.reason: Reuters' report on the renewed Supreme Court application was published before the prior cutoff and described the pending state already captured from Associated Press. Ukraine and proposed U.S.-Russia-China meeting coverage produced no new agreement, order or verified lifecycle change.

rejected_candidates.title: External archive discovery leads
rejected_candidates.reason: All four registered archives were rechecked at their primary project pages or official public endpoints. Measurements remain in their separate upstream units, and no external item advanced without original-source inspection and full Record review.
